table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Student.Name,   
	Student.StudentCode,   
	Student.RegNo,   
	Student.FName,   
	Student.FNIC,   
	Student.CurrentClass,
	Student.Gender,   
	Student.BirthDate,   
	Student.Phone,   
	Student.Mobile,   
	Student.Status, 
	RollNo =  
		(SELECT C=MAX(SC.RollNo) 
		FROM StudentClass SC, Class C 
		WHERE SC.StudentCode=Student.StudentCode AND 
			Student.CurrentClass= SC.ClassCode AND
			SC.ClassCode = C.ClassCode AND C.Active='Y'),
	RegisteredBy = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=Student.RegisteredBy),
	RegisteredOn=Student.RegisteredOn,
	LastUpdateBy = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=Student.LastUpdateBy)
FROM 
	Student  
ORDER BY 
	Student.Name ASC,   
	Student.RegNo ASC
